banned.claim: Cures or treats dog anxiety or separation anxiety
banned.why: Disease claim - supplements may only say 'promotes calm' or 'supports healthy stress relief', not treat/cure a condition.

banned.claim: Treats or prevents periodontal or dental disease
banned.why: Disease claim - use 'supports oral health' and 'freshens breath', not treatment of a diagnosed disease.

banned.claim: Clinically proven to support your dog's health
banned.why: The FAQ uses 'clinically proven' with no cited study - 'clinically proven' is banned without a cited study.

banned.claim: Freshen breath instantly / calm in seconds guaranteed
banned.why: Specific timeline to a health outcome and implied guarantee are banned for this category.
Implying disease prevention is a disease claim; keep to structure/function language only.

banned.claim: Testimonials stating melts fixed a dog's separation anxiety
banned.why: Testimonials implying a disease benefit are treated as disease claims under the compliance rules.
